name: Begin SSO connector verification
description: Begin SSO connector verification Validates the user has added the DNS TXT record required for validating ownership of the domain they are trying to set up a connector for. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/sso_connectors/{sso_connector_id}/begin_verification
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/sso_connectors/{sso_connector_id}/begin_verification
Validates the user has added the DNS TXT record required for validating ownership of the domain they are trying to set up a connector for.
Required: account_id (path); sso_connector_id (path)

name: Delete SSO connector
description: Delete SSO connector Deletes an SSO connector from the account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/sso_connectors/{sso_connector_id}

name: Get all SSO connectors
description: Get all SSO connectors Lists all SSO connectors configured for the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/sso_connectors
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/sso_connectors
Lists all SSO connectors configured for the account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Get single SSO connector
description: Get single SSO connector Retrieves details for a specific SSO connector. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/sso_connectors/{sso_connector_id}

name: Initialize new SSO connector
description: Initialize new SSO connector Creates a new SSO connector for logging into Cloudflare through an identity provider. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/sso_connectors
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/sso_connectors
Creates a new SSO connector for logging into Cloudflare through an identity provider.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: body (body)
